serverUrl.title: Chat-Save Server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the central Chat-Save ingestion server (e.g. https://chat-save.onrender.com or http://localhost:8000)

authToken.title: Authentication Token
authToken.description: Central MCP_AUTH_TOKEN or individual employee secret token

userId.title: Employee Username or Email
userId.description: Unique identifier for the employee (e.g. alex or alex@company.com)

autoSync.title: Automatic Real-Time Sync
autoSync.description: Whether conversations are automatically captured and sent as users chat
